mappings.rationale: Both concern a farmer-family member holding a current or former listed public office. The cited PM-KISAN passage enumerates ministers, legislators, mayors, and District Panchayat chairpersons; confirm the existing fact's listed offices cover the full set.

The existing fact and gold concern serving or retired family-member employees and the same lower-grade exceptions. Confirm the existing definition covers the passage's PSEs, attached/autonomous institutions, and regular local-body employees.
The cited PM-KISAN clause matches the candidate fact's family-member scope, monthly INR 10,000 threshold, and stated lower-grade exceptions.
The full cited PM-KISAN clause specifies listed professions registered with professional bodies and carrying out practice, matching the candidate fact's family-member scope.
Both the cited PM-KISAN and PMKMDY exclusions refer directly to institutional landholders.

The project owner approved reuse of the family-level State/UT land-record fact for PM-KISAN only, and approved the distinct applicant-scoped PMKMDY fact and English/Hindi/Marathi question drafts. The owner accepts the reviewed myScheme clause as final project evidence despite the official-guidelines cross-check not confirming the exact 2019-08-01 wording; this is not represented as primary-source verification. Production intake was requested but cannot be activated under the app's current synthetic-only consent/privacy policy and without a PMKMDY scheme package.
